title: Glowing sushi roll
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- plate shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='82' rx='38' ry='9' fill='#1a3a4a'/>
  <!-- plate -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='78' rx='36' ry='8' fill='#2a6a8a'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='76' rx='32' ry='6.5' fill='#3a8aaa'/>
  <!-- plate rim highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='76' rx='32' ry='6.5' fill='none' stroke='#5ac8e8' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <!-- nori glow aura -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='48' r='26' fill='#1a2a1a' opacity='0.4'/>
  <!-- nori outer ring -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='48' r='24' fill='#1e3a2a'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='48' r='24' fill='none' stroke='#2e6a4a' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- rice ring -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='48' r='20' fill='#e8e0d0'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='48' r='20' fill='none' stroke='#fff8e8' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- rice grain dots -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='40' r='1.2' fill='#fffaf0'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='34' r='1.2' fill='#fffaf0'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='34' r='1.2' fill='#fffaf0'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='40' r='1.2' fill='#fffaf0'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='52' r='1.2' fill='#fffaf0'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='60' r='1.2' fill='#fffaf0'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='62' r='1.2' fill='#fffaf0'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='54' r='1.2' fill='#fffaf0'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='46' r='1.2' fill='#fffaf0'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='46' r='1.2' fill='#fffaf0'/>
  <!-- filling - salmon -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='48' r='11' fill='#f08a5a'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='48' r='11' fill='none' stroke='#ffb07a' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- salmon stripes -->
  <path d='M42 44 Q50 40 58 44' stroke='#ffd0a8' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M43 50 Q50 47 57 50' stroke='#ffd0a8' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cucumber -->
  <circle cx='46' cy='45' r='4' fill='#4ac87a'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='45' r='4' fill='none' stroke='#7af0a8' stroke-width='1'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='45' r='1.8' fill='#a8f8c8'/>
  <!-- avocado -->
  <ellipse cx='55' cy='52' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#9ad858'/>
  <ellipse cx='55' cy='52' rx='4' ry='3' fill='none' stroke='#c8f890' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- tamago -->
  <rect x='48' y='53' width='6' height='4' rx='1' fill='#f8d050'/>
  <rect x='48' y='53' width='6' height='4' rx='1' fill='none' stroke='#ffe890' stroke-width='0.8'/>
  <!-- glow sparkles -->
  <g fill='#a8f8ff'>
    <circle cx='28' cy='28' r='1.5'/>
    <circle cx='72' cy='30' r='1.2'/>
    <circle cx='76' cy='56' r='1.4'/>
    <circle cx='24' cy='58' r='1.1'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='20' r='1.6'/>
    <circle cx='34' cy='70' r='1'/>
    <circle cx='68' cy='70' r='1'/>
  </g>
  <g fill='#fff8a8' opacity='0.9'>
    <circle cx='30' cy='34' r='0.8'/>
    <circle cx='70' cy='38' r='0.8'/>
    <circle cx='32' cy='62' r='0.8'/>
    <circle cx='66' cy='62' r='0.8'/>
  </g>
</svg>
